judgement.reason: This repository is the ClickHouse database server (the selected image runs ClickHouse Keeper, a coordination server on port 2181), not a web application, and the image installs a released package instead of building this source.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME "${DEFAULT_DATA_DIR}" (docker/keeper/Dockerfile), VOLUME /var/lib/clickhouse (docker/keeper/Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: The ClickHouse Keeper image stores coordination logs and snapshots in its data directory, and no shown setting moves that state to a managed service.

reviews.findingEvidence: Server binds only to a loopback address: listen(PORT, '127.0.0.1', () (.claude/skills/diff-review/server.mjs)
reviews.reason: The loopback bind is in a Claude skill helper script, not in the production image, which starts ClickHouse Keeper through /entrypoint.sh.
